newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel opens down 10 pct in Paris.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel opens down 10 pct in Paris.

text.p: Shares in distressed Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel SA /Plc opened down 10 percent at 6.75 francs per share on Monday.
Eurotunnel said on Sunday that tunnel repairs will take at least three months after a fire last week seriously damaged the rail system.

A spokesman for the French Stock Market's association SBF said that unlike other French shares, Eurotunnel would not be temporarely suspended if it fell below its 6.10 franc lower limit because it is also listed in London.
He said, however, that the Bourse could interrupt trading if there was an important fall and it also had the option to suspend the share altogether if needed.
A spokeswoman for Eurotunnel in Paris said it was still unclear when the tunnel could re-open as the company was awaiting approval from the inter-government commisssion.
